subject.title: improve(mattermost): restart only the changed account on config reload

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `ChannelPlugin.reload.accountScopedRestart` as a public capability and enable it for Mattermost?
rationale: The patch proves a useful optimization, but only maintainers can decide whether account-isolation guarantees should become a permanent plugin API contract and which plugins may opt in.

options.title: Sponsor and reopen
options.body: Approve the opt-in API direction, document its isolation requirements, refresh the branch, and proceed with exact-head review.

options.title: Keep it Mattermost-internal
options.body: Request a narrower owner-specific implementation that avoids exposing a general plugin API until more channels need the capability.

options.title: Decline the direction
options.body: Keep whole-channel reload semantics as the single supported lifecycle path and leave this PR closed despite its performance benefit.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and reopen
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in API direction, document its isolation requirements, refresh the branch, and proceed with exact-head review.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is repeated ownership of the public channel-plugin contract surface affected by this decision.
